name: Naruse Kobato
source:
He is Shiroha's grandfather who is called Old Man Naruse. 

Scars of proof of his long military service are engraved all over his body. Regardless, the most painful of all was grandmother's lecture.

He is an expert on the Torishiro Island's "Underwater Interval Technique" which is the island's tradition.
